description: He wears a dark olive-green knee-length noble tunic with gold-toned knotwork borders along the front, cuffs and hem. A broad brown leather belt with decorated metal fittings and a round central buckle secures the waist, its long tail hanging in front. A richly textured green-and-brown checked cloak drapes around the shoulders and down the sides, with knotwork edging and a large round shoulder brooch. Brown trousers and tall dark brown leather boots wrapped with diagonal leather straps complete the ensemble. Fabrics look thick and woven with a wool-like texture, but exact fibers are uncertain. Torso and limbs remain covered; no headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
